description: Get the result of a trademark check that was still running, or the next part of a long full report. Pass the search_id that check_trademark returned, and part when the report says it continues.

part.description: Which part of a long full report to return. Defaults to 1.

name: get_trademark_check

register.description: Source register, e.g. USPTO, EUIPO, WIPO.

risk.description: CRITICAL, HIGH, MEDIUM, LOW or INFO.

status.description: Register status, e.g. REGISTERED or a pending status.

conflicts_total.description: All conflicts found, across every part.

file_url.description: Link to file this mark with Arcangel AI.

part.description: Which part of the report this is.

parts.description: How many parts the report has. If part < parts, call get_trademark_check with part + 1.

risk_counts.description: Number of conflicting marks per risk level.

signed_in.description: Whether the caller is signed in with Arcangel (needed for full reports).

status.description: running: call get_trademark_check with search_id after retry_after_seconds.

verdict.description: Plain-language summary of the register findings.

title: Get a trademark check result
